policy: Vaticanus remains governing; only explicitly identified deterministic rules may admit an English annotation.

rules.VEA-001-UNIQUE-EXACT-TRANSPOSITION: Admit only a one-to-one identical normalized form among unused words in the same verse, with TAGNT contextual gloss and a resolving TBESG entry.
rules.VEA-W01-NO-UNIQUE-EXACT-COUNTERPART: Withhold where no unique identical unused TAGNT counterpart exists.
rules.VEA-W02-TEXTUAL-DIFFERENCE: Withhold a similar but non-identical form pending independent lexical adjudication.
